chapter: 《能量的转化与守恒》 (Energy Conversion and Conservation)
note: The design doc's skill table is PRELIMINARY (基于样本的初步标签) — it is not the full curriculum. This v1 taxonomy must be reviewed against the teacher's actual materials and signed off before it is treated as authoritative.

skills.description: Determine whether a specified force does work: a force does work only if the object moves a displacement along the force's direction.
skills.name_en: Judge whether a given force does work from force and displacement along the force direction
skills.name_zh: 根据力与沿力方向的位移判断指定力做功

skills.description: Multi-step: judge the effective displacement over which the push acts, then combine with friction force to compute the work done against friction.
skills.name_en: Determine the displacement needed to push the board off and compute work against friction
skills.name_zh: 判断推下木板所需的位移并结合摩擦力计算功

skills.description: Estimate missing quantities with reasonable orders of magnitude (e.g. mass, height, time), then compute average power P = W / t.
skills.name_en: Estimate physical quantities and compute average power
skills.name_zh: 估算物理量并计算平均功率

skills.description: Distinguish the concepts of work and power; identify and exclude conditions that do not affect the comparison.
skills.name_en: Compare work vs power and exclude irrelevant conditions
skills.name_zh: 比较功与功率，排除无关条件

skills.description: Compute work done by gravity W = G * h, using the vertical displacement of the object's center of mass.
In a multi-phase motion (e.g. a jump: crouch, push-off, airborne), identify during which phases a force does positive/negative/zero work. Recorded separately from the other Q11 sub-parts.
skills.name_en: Identify the phases in which work is done

skills.description: Reason about the kinetic energy at the highest point of a vertical jump (velocity zero => kinetic energy zero). Recorded separately from the other Q11 sub-parts.
Compute average power over repeated jumps: total work over total time. Recorded separately from the other Q11 sub-parts.
Reason about elastic potential energy in a deformation/restoration process. Recorded separately from the other Q12 blanks.
Analyze how forces acting on the object change as its velocity changes (e.g. net force direction vs acceleration). Recorded separately from the other Q12 blanks.
